Figure 3: Panel A - Pseudocoloured confocal microscopy images (micrographs) of NIH3T3 cells expressing H1.1-mPAGFP, RCC1-mPAGFP, H1t-PAGFP at different time points, with scale bar. Panel B - Line/scatter graphs (plots) showing normalized intensity vs time for H1.1, RCC1, H1t, with insets.
Panel A: micrograph. Scale bar present in bottom row (H1t) at right edge, white bar. Caption states "Scale bar 10 μm." Panel B: plot, not applicable.

Panel A: micrograph, not applicable. Panel B: plots of normalized intensity vs time, scatter-type traces for euchromatin (red) and heterochromatin (green) showing many individual time-point measurements as scatter dots, with fitted solid lines (models). Insets show average with error bars and also scatter points with error bars.

Panel A: micrograph, not applicable. Panel B: insets show error bars (vertical bars) on data points in the early time point averaged response plots. Caption text: "Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin." No explicit definition of error bar type (SD, SEM, CI) or n given in the caption.
